Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses TurboID for proximity labeling of interaction partners of TTC5 and SCAPER, followed by TMT labeling for quantitative analysis. Two different instruments were used: Q Exactive Plus (DDA/MS2) and Orbitrap Eclipse (RTS-MS3).

scope: To isolate biotinylated proteins for mass spectrometry analysis, cells were seeded in 150 mm plates and grown to ∼ 80% confluency.
Lysates were then incubated on a rotating wheel with ∼ 50 μl of streptavidin-coupled magnetic beads (Pierce 88817) for 2 hours at 4°C.
Proteins bound to beads were reduced with 2 mM DTT in 2 M urea buffer and sequencing grade trypsin (Promega) was added to a final concentration of 5 ng/μl.

Quantitative mass spectrometry revealed that a poorly studied protein named SCAPER (S-phase cyclin A associated protein residing in the ER) was the only protein whose biotinylation was strongly reduced in TTC5(K97A) cells
subcellular_fraction: cytosolic extracts were prepared by lysis in 1 ml digitonin lysis buffer per 150 mm plate for 10–15 min on ice

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on proteins affinity-purified using streptavidin beads following TurboID proximity labeling in cytosolic extracts.
